title: Reach&Grasp
provider: Di Domenico et al. 2025 (IIT, Bielefeld University)
about: 10 subjects, 16 right-arm tasks (hand and wrist movements, grasps, reach-grasp-manipulate) with a 58-taxel piezoresistive glove over a CyberGlove, Vicon joint angles and EMG. Touch only, no video.

hardware.d: Piezoresistive fabric lining on the palm side of the right hand: palm 17, index 9, middle 8, ring 8, little 9, thumb 7 · uncalibrated · 100 Hz

hardware.v: CyberGlove I inside the tactile glove

hardware.d: Arm, thorax and finger MCP joint angles only, no marker trajectories · 100 Hz
OT Bioelettronica Sessantaquattro and Cometa Wave Plus · 2 kHz (not shown)

notes: Paper: Scientific Data 12:233, 2025, doi:10.1038/s41597-025-04552-5. Data: IIT Dataverse version 1.0, CC BY 4.0; layout files and repetition events from the authors' code repository (github.com/DarioDiDomenico/SData_ReachGrasp, MIT). Taxels are painted onto the pads of the paper's Fig. 2A drawing. The glove is not calibrated (the paper says readings cannot be related to N or Pa); ring-fingertip taxels rdd, rdo, rdm malfunction (paper).
